blocks.heading: A scalp that gets greasy fast, hair that breaks after every wash
quotes: “I wash it in the morning and it is greasy by the afternoon.”
“After brushing there is a whole clump of broken hair in the brush.”

explainer.heading: Washing well keeps the scalp clean without snapping the hair
body: Excess oil, sweat and product residue build up and leave the scalp greasy and itchy. Scrubbing with nails or rubbing hard scratches the scalp and breaks hair.
Hair Boost is a scalp care shampoo. The bottle label states three uses: helps prevent hair breakage, leaves hair soft and smooth, helps hair feel stronger and look thicker.

items.heading: A scalp that gets oily fast
items.body: Wash regularly and massage with the fingertips to lift excess oil and sebum.

items.heading: Fine hair that breaks when brushed or washed
items.body: Hydrolysed keratin and collagen keep strands softer and less likely to snap when detangling.

items.heading: Very dry, frizzy hair that will not sit right
items.body: Kerasilk Smooth suits dry, frizzy hair better. You can also add the Collagen Deep Shot mask after washing.

items.heading: An inflamed scalp, thick scale or wounds
items.body: See a dermatologist first. A care shampoo does not replace an examination.

blocks.heading: Ingredients on the bottle label
blocks.intro: The first three are printed inside the Hairroot Boost Complex panel. Hydrolysed keratin and collagen appear in the English description on the label.
blocks.caption: Soap pod, soapberry and holy basil come from the brand's ingredient image and do not appear on the front label. No concentrations are printed. The full INCI list is printed on the product packaging.

rows.name: Kopexil (Diaminopyrimidine Oxide)
rows.role: An active commonly found in shampoos for hair-root care.

rows.name: Redensyl™
rows.role: A branded active used in scalp and hair-root care products.

rows.name: Caffeine
rows.role: A familiar ingredient in shampoos aimed at the scalp.

rows.name: Hydrolyzed Keratin
rows.role: Hydrolysed keratin coats the strand, keeping hair softer and less prone to breaking when brushed.

rows.name: Hydrolyzed Collagen
rows.role: Hydrolysed collagen helps the strand hold moisture and feel softer.

rows.name: Soap pod and soapberry (bồ kết, bồ hòn)
rows.role: Gentle cleansing. The brand says they help reduce dandruff and oiliness.

rows.name: Holy basil (hương nhu tía)
rows.role: The brand says it soothes and leaves the scalp feeling fresh.

blocks.heading: How to wash

items.heading: Wet hair and scalp
items.body: Use clean water. This rinses away some dirt and oil and softens the hair.

items.heading: Lather and wash gently for 1–2 minutes
items.body: Take enough into your hand, work up a lather and apply to hair and scalp. Massage in circles with the fingertips, not the nails.

items.heading: Rinse well and pat dry
items.body: Rinse until no foam is left. Pat dry with a soft towel, then move on to a mask or scalp care step if you use one.

blocks.footnote: If hair is very dirty, wash a second time. The brand presents it as a shampoo for daily use.

items.a: Wash with Hair Boost, rinse well, towel the hair until just damp, then roll Peel Ion onto the scalp. Peel Ion is not rinsed out.
